action: Authored New-PlanFrame.ps1, New-MakeStep.ps1, New-CheckFrame.ps1, Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 under each skill's scripts/, each with Write-Error+exit1 reject codes matching its own reject.*.asset.md and an ordered-hashtable frame stamped with ts/role/seq/type.
Wrote a scratch-trail test harness (mint via New-Trail.ps1 -OutputPath, then orchestrate/plan/make/check/reflect-and-seed) and ran it for real.

Re-ran the full four-script loop end to end: mint, plan, make, check, reflect-and-seed all succeeded and produced correctly shaped JSONL (steps/success_criteria/criteria all plain arrays, trail_id populated). Also smoke-tested four reject paths (no-orchestrate-frame equivalent, no-plan-frame, no-check-frame, trail-not-found) -- all fired the correct reject code.

Authored New-OrchestrateFrame.ps1: does not mint or link a trail itself (New-Trail.ps1 still owns minting), but its own precondition checks (exists, unsealed, not already claimed) double as the link-path verification for a supplied trail id. Re-ran the full loop with this script as the first real step (mint -> orchestrate -> plan -> make -> check -> reflect-and-seed) plus a trail-linked reject smoke test (claiming the same trail twice) -- all passed.

Updated run.*.asset.md, references/README.md, and SKILL.md for all five skills (orchestrate/plan/make/check/reflect-and-seed) to say 'call scripts/X.ps1' instead of 'append a line ... write it directly'; updated command.make.asset.md's result shape to include handed_off_to, matching what the script actually returns; updated .claude/skills/run-pmcro-cycle/SKILL.md's table and text to list each script and drop the now-false claim that hand-writing the file directly was an equally valid implementation choice.

Rebuilt all six plugin zips via New-PluginZip.ps1 and reopened each: 0 backslash-path entries, .claude-plugin/plugin.json present in all six, each new script entry (skills/*/scripts/*.ps1) present with forward-slash paths. Ran claude plugin validate against all five affected plugin directories -- all five passed clean.

First real run surfaced two bugs. One: trail_id came back blank when a script was called with -TrailPath instead of -TrailId, since the output object referenced the never-set -TrailId parameter directly. Two: New-MakeStep failed with unknown-step-index because plan.jsonl steps field was corrupted -- Windows PowerShell 5.1 ConvertTo-Json serializes an array that came from ConvertFrom-Json as an object with value and Count properties instead of a plain JSON array, confirmed via isolated repro, unless the array is re-wrapped with the array subexpression operator first. Fixed both: read trail_id back from disposition.json in every script, and re-wrap every ConvertFrom-Json-derived array before assigning it into the frame object.

A third bug surfaced during this very logging pass, using the finished scripts against this real trail: New-MakeStep hand-off logic counted every plan step as remaining for Maker, including a step assigned to Checker, so it would never hand off. Fixed by filtering to only subject_agent maker steps when computing what remains. Re-ran the isolated repro to confirm the fix.
